lines.targetText: We need to talk about the missing information.

lines.targetText: In my opinion, the real problem is unclear information.

lines.arabicTranslation: في رأيي، the real problem is unclear information.
lines.pronunciation: In my opinion, the real problem is unclear information.

lines.targetText: Because people cannot plan without facts.

lines.arabicTranslation: لأن people cannot plan without facts.
lines.pronunciation: Because people cannot plan without facts.

lines.targetText: I suggest that we should share the numbers openly.

lines.targetText: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.
